name: Kaonashi no Double
source:
An entity known as "God" descends upon this world on a meteor, granting wishes accompanied by curses.
When a boy wakes up with no form, his little brother Cloena suggests that God might lift the curse.
And so they begin their journey in search of God...

[From [url=http://vgperson.com/games/facelessdouble.htm]vgperson[/url]]
